[ GOOD QUESTIONS ]

A few things
worth knowing.

Will Debloat Android change anything on my phone?+

No. This release uses a fixed set of read-only ADB queries. It cannot disable, uninstall, clear app data, or change settings.

Do I need to root my phone?+

No root is required. You need Android SDK Platform Tools on your computer and USB debugging authorized on your phone. The skill guides you through setup.

Does my device information stay private?+

The Python tool saves reports locally and has no telemetry. Your AI agent may send tool output to its provider. Installed app names can reveal personal interests, so the skill asks before reading them.

Can it tell me which apps are safe to remove?+

Package-name clues are a starting point for research. They do not establish tracking, harmful behavior, dependencies, or safe removal. Debloat Android keeps that uncertainty visible.

Can I use it with a cloud agent?+

The agent needs local command execution on the computer connected to your phone. Installing a skill into a cloud session does not give it USB access. You can try the synthetic demo without a phone.
